name: FineWeb
description: A large-scale, cleaned and deduplicated web-text corpus derived from Common Crawl for language-model pretraining. Dataset access is provided through Hugging Face and may require accepting its access conditions; this record does not distribute corpus data.
citation: Penedo, G., others. (2024). The FineWeb Datasets: Decanting the Web for the Finest Text Data at Scale. arXiv:2406.17557. https://arxiv.org/abs/2406.17557

license.notes: FineWeb is an aggregate of web-crawled material, not a corpus with a single standard SPDX license. Access is gated by Hugging Face dataset conditions; those conditions do not grant blanket rights to underlying source content. Review upstream terms and source-content rights before use or redistribution.
